mapper.sql: h.SALE_ID, h.SALE_NO, TO_CHAR( h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_ID, w.WAREHOUSE_CODE, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.NOTE, h.PROGRESS_STATUS, h.DELETED_YN, TO_CHAR( h.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR( h.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS UPDATED_AT
FROM SALE h LEFT JOIN BIZ_PARTNER p ON p.PARTNER_ID = h.PARTNER_ID LEFT JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON w.WAREHOUSE_ID = h.WAREHOUSE_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON a.ASSIGNEE_ID = h.ASSIGNEE_ID
mapper.select: SELECT l.SALE_LINE_ID, l.SALE_ID, l.SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID, l.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_CODE, l.ITEM_NAME, l.SPECIFICATION, l.UNIT, l.QUANTITY, l.UNIT_PRICE, l.SUPPLY_AMOUNT, l.VAT_AMOUNT, l.TOTAL_AMOUNT, l.NOTE, l.DELETED_YN FROM SALE_LINE l JOIN SALE h ON h.SALE_ID = l.SALE_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = l.ITEM_ID WHERE l.SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND h.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY l.SALE_LINE_ID ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SALE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SALE ( SALE_ID, SALE_NO, BUSINESS_DATE, PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_NAME, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, NOTE, PROGRESS_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{saleId}, LPAD( TO_CHAR(#{saleId}), GREATEST( 5, LENGTH(TO_CHAR(#{saleId})) ), '0' ), TO_DATE( #{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ), #{partnerId}, #{partnerName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{note}, 'CONFIRMED', LOCALTIMESTAMP, LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE SALE SET BUSINESS_DATE = TO_DATE( #{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ), PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId}, PARTNER_NAME = #{partnerName}, WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId}, WAREHOUSE_NAME = #{warehouseName}, ASSIGNEE_ID = #{assigneeId}, ASSIGNEE_NAME = #{assigneeName}, NOTE = #{note}, UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SALE_LINE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SALE_LINE ( SALE_LINE_ID, SALE_ID, SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, SPECIFICATION, UNIT, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, SUPPLY_AMOUNT, VAT_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, NOTE, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{saleLineId}, #{saleId}, #{salesOrderLineId}, #{itemId}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyAmount}, #{vatAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{note}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE SALE_LINE SET SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID = #{salesOrderLineId}, ITEM_ID = #{itemId}, ITEM_NAME = #{itemName}, SPECIFICATION = #{specification}, UNIT = #{unit}, QUANTITY = #{quantity}, UNIT_PRICE = #{unitPrice}, SUPPLY_AMOUNT = #{supplyAmount}, VAT_AMOUNT = #{vatAmount}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount}, NOTE = #{note} WHERE SALE_LINE_ID = #{saleLineId} AND SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
